Snoopy!

My favourite character

Why I Love Snoopy

Snoopy is my favourite character from the Peanuts comic strip (created by Charles M. Schulz.) Even though Snoopy is Charlie Brown's pet beagle, Snoopy is usually the one in charge. Snoopy has a huge imagination and often pretends to be a pilot, a writer, or a famous adventurer. He is always up to something and at the same time always completely himself. He has a cute (if sometimes tit-for-tat) friendship with the little yellow bird Woodstock, who at night can also be found on top of Snoopy's doghouse.

My Favourite Things About Snoopy

  • He reminds me of my dog.
  • He has a big personality.
  • I like hand drawn animation.
  • He is funny without needing to say a word.

Snoopy's World

Snoopy first appeared back in 1950 and has entertained readers ever since. Snoopy's simply iconic design and sunny personality allow him to continue to be loved by new generations of fans around the world.
